summary: chubin/wttr.in uses opencagedata for Geocoding location names (also LocationIQ-style "iq" provider supported) through raw HTTP in 3 places; wttr.in for Upstream weather data (WWO j1 format) via configurable baseUrl through raw HTTP in 1 place; wttr.in-uplink for Proxy of requests to backend uplink servers (likely internal, uncertain) through raw HTTP in 1 place.
agentSummary:
I found three outbound HTTP integrations in wttr.in and recorded each one. I read only the Go code that makes the requests and the config file. I didn't read the shell scripts or the `share/defs/ds/*/info.json` files.

- **OpenCage geocoding** (`opencagedata`, raw HTTP): turns location names into lat/lon. The shared `makeQuery` in `internal/location/nominatim.go:59` makes the call. It is invoked from `nominatim_opencage.go:27` and, for the LocationIQ-style `iq` type, from `nominatim_locationiq.go:23`. The URL and token come from `share/config/config.yaml`, and nothing pins an API version. The LocationIQ host isn't in the repo, so I couldn't confirm it. It is likely `locationiq.com`, and I recorded it under the OpenCage usage with a note.
- **Weather data** (`wttr.in`, raw HTTP): `internal/weather/weatherer_wwo.go:103` fetches weather JSON from the configurable `weather.wwo.baseUrl`. The default config points it at wttr.in's own `?format=j1` endpoint. The `{key}` placeholder means it can also be pointed at World Weather Online. The code strips the optional `data` wrapper from the response.
- **Uplink proxy** (`wttr.in-uplink`, raw HTTP): `internal/uplink/uplink.go:103` forwards incoming requests to up to four backend servers at configured addresses. This is probably the project's own backend rather than an external API. I recorded it with a note saying so.

Two things I left out on purpose. The MaxMind GeoLite2 lookup in `internal/ip` reads a local `.mmdb` file, so there is no network call. The `share/defs/ds/*/info.json` files are only descriptive entries for other weather providers. They have no call sites.

`build.sh:144` also downloads a CSS file from raw.githubusercontent.com at build time. I didn't record that one.
